description: Department of Local Government-Northern Province - Details of new Chairman for the Karainagar Pradeshiya Sabha in Northern Province
categorisation: This gazette notice announces the election results for a local government position (Chairman of Karainagar Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance and Amendment Act. It specifically deals with electoral processes and declarations at the local authority level, fitting the definition of Elections Gazettes (Type 7) which includes "election results and declarations" and "candidate nominations and registrations."
